purpose: Organize exact content for independent review; does not authorize acquisition/raw release or certify evidence truth.

profiles.existing_05_21: Retrospective exposed source; original128 block paths retained as request lineage only.
profiles.existing_05_28: Retrospective exploratory only in current model-selection lineage; source-specific candidatev0.2 request remains170null leaves/HOLD.
profiles.fresh_source: New independently reviewed identity/domain and prospective model/score freeze; no candidate counts/crop/budget transferred automatically.

artifacts.title: Authority and independence
artifacts.required_content: Actual calibrating body, scope, reference standards/methods, acquisition/device identity, independence/conflict declaration, and the externally accepted authority decision with its date and grounds. A name, URL, accreditation label or self-asserted hash alone does not establish acceptance.

artifacts.title: Custody, configuration and domain
artifacts.required_content: Exact acquisition/source IDs; SHA-256 and byte counts accepted through independent custody; record/group/sample counts, channel ordering, crop/time-grid definition and units; compiled acquisition binary, API/firmware, devices, wiring, trigger and filter settings; pre-read manifest and prior exposure history. All source counts and crop lengths are acquisition-specific, not inherited.

artifacts.title: Per-channel amplitude calibration
artifacts.required_content: One row per actual channel: applied gain and offset, intervals about them, valid nominal-input range, calibrated nonlinearity and noise/quantization in post-decoder volts, supporting methods/data and proof every claimed sample is covered. Separate serialization, ADC, analog front-end and physical-source errors.

artifacts.title: Clock and time-to-voltage propagation
artifacts.required_content: Actual calibrated rate interval, common-grid model or explicit device grids, cropped-start/trigger convention, origin/skew/jitter bounds, domain and source-bound derivative or band proof, and a justified waveform-vector error enclosure. Shared trigger does not prove shared clocks.

artifacts.title: Passband and alias budget
artifacts.required_content: Actual analog/digital transfer for the acquisition, declared input band below the lower calibrated Nyquist rate, bounded in-band distortion and out-of-band alias contribution, validity domain and supporting measurements/proofs. An averaging flag or nominal sample rate is insufficient.

artifacts.title: Joint error coverage and allocation
artifacts.required_content: Choose a simultaneous deterministic enclosure OR a justified statistical joint-coverage route. Define population/record/bin/component domain, dependence and coverage event, use all errors exactly once, and return exact per-vector and aggregate score error budgets in the declared coordinates. No default independence, covariance, confidence level or root-sum-square cancellation.
artifacts.inactive_route_rule: Inactive-route fields may be explicitly N/A with the selected route and rationale; an external reviewer must inspect the active proof. The packet has not selected a route.

artifacts.title: Validated computation
artifacts.required_content: Exact operators, source/version/precision, parsing and serialization, mean removal, window representation, FFT/normalization and comparison rounding, and separately justified DC/RMS/spectral and prediction solver error bounds. Reproducible proof commands and logs; FFT agreement and bin width are not error enclosures.

artifacts.title: Primary physical model
artifacts.required_content: Versioned equations, parameter domains and units with independent source/calibration; complex link amplitude retained; actual state/action structure, constitutive assumptions and validity domain. Mathematical group vocabulary or a nominal frequency is not a UD physical identification.

artifacts.title: State, preparation and readout
artifacts.required_content: Physical realization and independently justified mapping between model states/actions and measured voltages, including missing quadratures/phase, units, uncertainty and validity domain. Initial-state/preparation ranges and their independent lineage; propagate state-estimation error separately.

artifacts.title: Drive, feedback, loss and energy
artifacts.required_content: Actual drive amplitude/frequency/phase/history, feedback and loss with uncertainties; source-work/energy balance and explicit model-discrepancy allowance. Public filename amplitudes, default code or residual-zero assumptions do not supply these.

artifacts.title: Justified physical comparator
artifacts.required_content: Explicit alternative equations, parameter domains/units and readout in the same measured coordinates; scientific justification for this alternative and the question it discriminates. Descriptive median/interpolation is not a physical null; do not invent a gauge-breaking model.

artifacts.title: Pre-outcome model and score freeze
artifacts.required_content: Before any new fit or scored outcome access: source selection, train/validation/test lineage, solver/bounds/initialization/precision/termination/ties/failures, physical model and comparator hashes, voltage-vector L2 and global max-absolute scores and error conventions, predeclared margin and its independent rationale. Retain every failure/HOLD; no outcome-selected retries or zero imputation.

artifacts.title: Genuinely fresh source and error coverage
artifacts.required_content: Independent custody/exposure review for a new acquisition or demonstrably unseen source, selection independent of relevant outcomes, and model/score freeze before access. Separate calibration/time/alias/numerical and joint coverage for that source or a proved extension. Existing 05-21 and 05-28 exposure cannot be erased by new labels/hashes.

artifacts.title: Attributable external content review
artifacts.required_content: Actual reviewer identity, nonconstructor/conflict scope, inspected source hashes, methods/commands/versions/logs, reproduced results/HOLDs, discrepancies, limitations and dated attributable verdict. Separate authority acceptance and custodian ruling; the blank return form is not an attestation.
